companies.name: ASEテクノロジー・ホールディング

relations.text: ASEの年次報告は、TE Connectivity Ltd.から切り出した車載ワイヤレス事業を特別目的会社が取得したと述べている
relations.text_en: ASE's annual report says an SPV acquired the automotive wireless business carved out from TE Connectivity Ltd.

source.label: ASE Technology Holding 20-F
source.quote: The SPV then acquired the automotive wireless business (hereunder, the “Target Business”) carved out from an unrelated party, TE Connectivity Ltd.
source.note: 売却先としての関係です。
source.note_en: Relationship as the buyer of a divested business.

companies.name: バンク・オブ・アメリカ

relations.text: TE Connectivityは、Bank of America, N.A.が管理代理人を務めるクレジット契約(2024年4月24日付)の関連契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: TE Connectivity is party to an assumption and joinder agreement (September 24, 2024) under a credit agreement dated April 24, 2024 with Bank of America, N.A. as administrative agent

source.label: TE Connectivity 10-K
source.quote: Assumption and Joinder Agreement, dated September 24, 2024, by TE Connectivity plc, TE Connectivity Switzerland Ltd. , and Bank of America, N.A., as administrative agent under that certain Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, dated April 24, 2024
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: Tyco Electronics Group S.A.を借入人とする5年のシニア・クレジット契約(2024年4月24日付)で、Bank of America, N.A.が管理代理人を務める
relations.text_en: Bank of America, N.A. is administrative agent under the Second Amended and Restated Five-Year Senior Credit Agreement dated April 24, 2024, with Tyco Electronics Group S.A. as borrower

source.label: TE Connectivity 10-K
source.quote: Second Amended and Restated Five-Year Senior Credit Agreement, dated April 24, 2024, by and among Tyco Electronics Group S.A., as borrower, TE Connectivity Ltd., as parent guarantor, the lenders party thereto, and Bank of America, N.A., as administrative agent
